 Litigation News Madras High Court refuses to restrain release of Ajay Devgn's Drishyam: The Conclusion on OTT 
 The order was passed amid a copyright dispute involving the remake rights of the Drishyam franchise. Drishyam 3 (Hindi) S N Thyagarajan Published on :  17 Nov 2026, 11:05 am 3 min read 
 Copied 
 Follow Us The Madras High Court recently refused to restrain the exploitation and distribution of the Hindi film Drishyam: The Conclusion , starring Ajay Devgn and Tabu, including its release on OTT platforms, amid a copyright dispute involving the remake rights of the Drishyam franchise [ Rajkumar Theatres Vs Wide Angle ].
